name: owlmeans
description: Build SaaS applications and AI agents on a specialized AI development pipeline — with the chatbots and data pipelines around them. Start your next project right, or unvibe the one you're stuck with.

interface.longDescription: OwlMeans builds SaaS applications and AI agents, with the chatbots and data pipelines around them, on a specialized AI development pipeline: it turns a plain-language description into a full-stack application (a web interface, an API and a background worker) and keeps developing it one user story at a time. From the conversation you can start a project, review and confirm its specification, plan and implement user stories, check the cloud preview, and publish the application to production with a custom domain, its own users and a GitHub repository. Generation and development run on OwlMeans and spend credits from your OwlMeans account; billing, plans and credit top-ups stay in the OwlMeans web app. Actions that cannot be undone, such as deleting a project, ask for confirmation first.
